meta.title: Vedic Gods — Deities of Sanātana Dharma
meta.description: Explore the Vedic gods and deities of Sanātana Dharma — Indra, Agni, Varuna, Vishnu, Shiva, and the divine pantheon.

vedic_gods.title: Vedic Gods
vedic_gods.description: The Vedic gods represent cosmic forces and universal principles. From Indra the king of gods to Agni the fire deity, each god embodies aspects of the supreme Brahman.
